title: File:Mars Valles Marineris.jpeg
author: NASA / USGS (see PIA04304 catalog page )
description: Global mosaic of 102 Viking 1 Orbiter images of Mars taken on orbit 1,334, 22 February 1980. The images are projected into point perspective, representing what a viewer would see from a spacecraft at an altitude of 2,500 km. At center is Valles Marineris, over 3000 km long and up to 8 km deep. Note the channels running up (north) from the central and eastern portions of Valles Marineris to the area at upper right, Chryse Planitia. At left are the three Tharsis Montes and to the south is ancient, heavily impacted terrain. (Viking 1 Orbiter, MG07S078-334SP) Some of the features in this mosaic are annotated in Wikimedia Commons.
changes: Recorte y movimiento de cámara; rótulos y comparación editorial superpuestos. Colores de la fuente conservados.
